top_news.title: Pittsburgh Pirates Takes 1-2 Win
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates beat St. Louis Cardinals 1-2. Alec Burleson: 1 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 4 AB Paul Skenes: 6.1 IP, 8 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 3 H Spencer Horwitz out on a sacrifice fly to center fielder Nathan Church. Ronny Simon scores.

top_news.title: Chicago White Sox Takes 9-1 Win
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox beat Kansas City Royals 9-1. Kyle Teel: 2 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 2 AB David Sandlin: 6.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 0 BB, 5 H Andrew Benintendi walks. Sam Antonacci scores. Kyle Teel to 3rd. Munetaka Murakami to 2nd.

top_news.title: Chicago Cubs Takes 1-2 Win
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs beat Miami Marlins 1-2. Seiya Suzuki: 2 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 3 AB Tyler Phillips: 4.0 IP, 2 K, 0 ER, 4 BB, 3 H Nico Hoerner singles on a line drive to left fielder Heriberto Hernández. Ian Happ scores.

top_news.title: Texas Rangers Takes 1-3 Win
